headline: BTC at 74,195 sits at the 24h low (74,058.7) with 15m/5m RSI at 36 and Fear at 32: buy the washed-out bounce toward 74,741 VWAP and 75,400 with a stop under 73,510.
argument:
Price is pressed against the bottom of its 24h range (low 74,058.7, high 75,568.18) and the 5m lower Bollinger band (74,142.09), with the last close at 74,195.42. RSI is 36.0 on 5m, 36.1 on 15m and 38.5 on 1h, the zone where intraday sellers have usually run out of fuel. The 5m MACD histogram is only -3.05 (prev -2.87), so downside momentum on the fastest frame is nearly flat, and ATR on 5m is just 103.97, so this selloff is slowing rather than accelerating.

The mean-reversion room is large. Session VWAP is 74,741.48, about 546 points (0.7%) above price, and the 1h upper Bollinger band is 75,403.35. Volume is 0.37x its 20-bar average on 5m, 0.35x on 15m and 0.09x on 1h, so this drift lower is on very thin participation, not capitulation selling.

Sentiment supports a contrarian long. Fear and Greed is 32 (Fear), up from 29 the previous reading, and perp funding is only +0.0088%, so leverage is not crowded long. The week's worst flow news is already known: US spot BTC ETFs lost $1.28B last week (The Block, Nov 7) and BTC fell 5.6% in one day, yet price is still holding 74k, which means much of the bad news is priced. The main risk is today's US CPI, which is a two-sided catalyst; a soft print would squeeze shorts into VWAP quickly. Risk is defined: stop below the 1h 50-bar low of 73,510.
